model.stratum: Forward display realization only: exact isotope counts, identity-preserving full/cutaway views and offline browser controls. Arbitrary illustrative FCC marker positions, not a physical nuclear lattice or loom-derived packing.
consumes: Declared illustrative marker layout and existing local browser tooling
provides: Interactive whole/cutaway nucleus schematic and checked screenshots
missing_constructors: Source-derived physical nuclear state or P/N/E-fitting packing; display does not assert either
model.next_falsifier: Wrong counts, lost identities, cutaway changing composition, missing scope warning, nonfunctional controls or browser errors reject this display.
